name: Oinari-sama to Dadaama Kozukurikon ~Nuicha Dame! Takusan Dashite Oneesan no Shikyuu Ippai ni Shite Kudasai ne♪~
original_name: お稲荷さまとダダ甘子作り婚～抜いちゃダメ！たくさん出してお姉さんの子宮いっぱいにしてくださいね♪～
source:
Takuma is a descendant of a noble family. One day, his grandfather tells him to infuse his pure spirit into a goddess who is under the influence of evil power. Takuma meets Yuuko, his childhood friend. Yuuko asks Takuma to purify her body, but he needs to ejaculate inside her and make a baby to purify her body.

[Edited from ErogeShop]
translation:
拓真出身名门。一天，祖父命令他把纯净的灵气注入一位受到邪恶力量影响的女神体内。拓真遇见了青梅竹马优子。优子请求拓真净化自己的身体，但净化的方法是让他在自己体内射精并孕育孩子。
